No proof pins any of them. (2) The baseline row said 'every later wave is SKIPPED', which is why the SKIPPED count was 4 and not 3 — it now says the held-up tasks are named in unfinished as never dispatched. (3) I added the re-edge judgment call (#979, ~3660) under autonomy, per the task's Context.
